Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X72/X72n1437.xml). Extensive Record of Chan Master Yongjue Yuanxian. Exact actor: Yongjue Yuanxian. Yongjue quotes Dongshan Liangjie’s verse and explains how crossing blades works within ‘arrival within both.’

Senses.Explanation: Dongshan Liangjie's verse for ‘arrival within both’ orders the capable hand not to avoid two crossing blades, then compares that hand to a lotus blooming in fire. Caoshan and later speakers preserve the line while questioning the five positions. Dongshan Liangjie's own record gives the line inside his verse for ‘arrival within both’: the capable hand does not avoid crossing blades and is immediately compared to a lotus blooming in fire. Caoshan Benji's record and Sanfeng Fazang's record transmit the same Dongshan verse; they are useful recensions but not new utterances. In Hongjue Min's record an unnamed questioner recites the line before asking about arrival within both and receives a blow. Yongjue Yuanxian reads the line inside the five positions: when adepts meet, light and dark intersect and taking and granting work together without a trace of deliberation, so neither blade wounds the hand. His explanation is a later use of Dongshan's line, not a new sense of the blades.

Senses.Explanation: The two halls disputing over the cat names the public case in which the eastern and western halls quarrel, Nanquan demands a word that will save the cat, and the assembly does not answer. The early Zutang Ji supplies a cause omitted by almost every later version: Nanquan’s chief seat kept a cat, the neighboring berth or its occupant suffered damage to a leg or foot, and a quarrel arose. The terse phrase “the neighboring berth or its occupant suffered damage to a leg or foot” (鄰床損腳) does not decide between damaged furniture and an injured person or explain how the damage happened. The Wumenguan instead has the eastern and western halls disputing and gives no cause. Much later, Liangting Jingting retells another origin: one hall leader says the precepts do not permit keeping cats and dogs, while the other wants the cat retained to control mice. These are source-attributed layers of the case, not details that can be silently combined into one historical account.

Senses.PreferredTarget: the two halls fight over the cat
AlternateTargets: the two halls dispute the cat
Senses.Explanation: Literally, “the two halls fight over the cat.” The exact phrase occurs 30 times in 29 allowlisted texts; expanded forms specify “the east and west halls.” In the Chan record it is the opening formula and a short name for Nanquan's cat case. The monks of the two halls dispute a cat; Nanquan holds it up and says, “If you can speak, I will not cut it,” no one answers, and he cuts it. When Zhaozhou returns, Nanquan recounts the event; Zhaozhou puts a sandal on his head and leaves, and Nanquan says that had Zhaozhou been present, he would have saved the cat. Later records quote the formula before asking what should have been said, composing verses on the case, or giving prose comments. The exact headword names the dispute that occasions the case; it is not a separate event from “Nanquan cuts the cat.” Elsewhere the corpus explicitly asks why Nanquan cut the cat if killing living beings is a major precept, but no occurrence of this exact formula states Nanquan's reason.
Senses.Note: The explicit precept question belongs to the linked cat-cutting family and is anchored under “cut the cat” and “Nanquan cuts the cat”, whose headwords it contains. It is not duplicated here as a headword-free occurrence. The corpus alternates the two graphs for “cat” (貓) and often adds “east and west” (東西).

Senses.Explanation: To ‘hand over with both hands’ is to make a complete and formal transfer of something entrusted to another. Masters promise to hand over a staff if someone can answer, and other witnesses transfer the ancestral robe, the ancestral family estate, or a teaching charge before the assembly. Some occurrences are conditional challenges; others describe an accomplished transmission.

Senses.Note: Sanyi closes a sermon on one law and many appearances with the pair. Yune uses it to answer gradual versus sudden awakening. Jiean, Yian, Luyan, and Gumei apply it in separate current comments and addresses. The wording sounds like filing two sections under an earlier category; in these turns its tidy classification is deliberately abrupt.

Occurrences.Kwic: 丞輞川？山僧只是不能忍事，往往向人道破，放年籤相似，不管人要不要送上門來。然一生止有者點熱腸，別無長處。倒弔起來，要點墨水也無。昨日受請，勉強打點得幾句，及乎陞座，卻一字也忘了。罷罷罷，休休休，四十餘年早白頭，破衲勝重裘，水邊林下得優游處且優游，青目睹人少，白眼笑王侯，殘霞落盡前峰外，又見飛鴻過渡頭。雲門云：『六不收。』」上堂。「鐘鳴鼓響下堂來，鬱鬱慚惶撥不開，若問舊時閒骨董，風吹黃葉滿蒼苔。大眾！古往今來列聖相傳，原秖得這些子，間或倚門傍戶，沾著纖毫氣息，便好驟千里追風之馬，展鵬搏六息之翼。火不能焚，水不能溺，入軍不避甲兵，入林不避兕虎。所以道：『世界闊多少，古鏡闊多少，劫運長多少，古鏡長多少。』山僧這裏雖是舊時文約，無不是以一償十，以十償百，以百償千，以千償萬。而況今日受檀越之請，陞此寶華王座，豈可蓋覆卻耶？」拈拄杖擊香几三下。上堂。「森羅萬象，一法之所印。龍門阬裏三條橋，鸚鵡峰前九曲嶺。猢猻慣上樹，蝦蟆跳入井。還知一法麼？兩段不同，收歸上科。」上堂。「山僧有生已來，將銅銕鑄得一副心肝，打得一副面皮，陵鑠諸方，氣吞佛祖。正恁麼時，咳唾之餘，便好擿地作金聲，彈指之下，不妨珠回而玉轉。三年前，跨入顯聖寺門，被箇絆腳索子跌上一交，便恁麼軟挼挼地，不知不覺，闖入箇野狐精，瞎禿丁夥隊裏，挨到此一時，提掇箇事，何啻千鈞之重，直至如今分疏不下，諸兄弟幸自可憐生，好箇時節。且道是甚時節？」豎拂子云：「甲子乙丑。」上堂。「衲僧家高高山頂立，深深海底行，十二時中，紅爐片雪，百千三昧。擿劍揮空，列聖籠罩不住，萬靈不可為儔，天共白雲曉，水和明月流。咄！」上堂。豎拂子云：「描不成，畫不就，添不得一絲，減不得一豆，三世諸佛趁伊不上，歷代祖師參前落後。盂上座只好做箇通事舍人，所以不敢輕于左右，學得神僊好方子，自然點石黃金就。」上堂。「陰極則陽生，臘盡春來早，略見梅花報早春，窗前適有呼春鳥。殷勤報與白頭人，怎奈白頭人不曉。古人也慮頭角生，佛法二字何曾表。今日檀信一以薦先，一以度生，請山僧陞座說法，可謂一椎兩當。山僧如搭箭之弦，勢不容己，打開布袋頭，將七珍八寶，撒向山門佛殿廚庫廂廊，填溝塞壑磕頭撞腦，曾無一字覆藏，好似向火焰裏添油，冰盤裏潑水。便饒恁麼，尚且有不知冷煖底漢子以手拊胸云：『氣逼殺人

Senses.Explanation: Two parts are called different and then placed under one earlier heading. The phrase borrows the language of ordering or classification to settle an exchange without an explanatory comparison. Six current speakers use it to end or redirect different questions, including gradual and sudden awakening.

Senses.PreferredTarget: Eyes meeting eyes
Senses.Note: Asked about the student’s own self, Shiqi replies, “Eyes meeting eyes”; the student’s next question about ending birth and death is treated as starting over. Tian’an says the same when asked what remains after host and guest disappear. Ruibai and Eryin use it for meeting exceptional visitors; Zhufeng answers the intent of the teacher’s arrival from the west, and Dabo answers a question about what remains after mountain and water vanish. Each turns a question about something elsewhere into the meeting already taking place.

Occurrences.Kwic: 正是無孔鐵槌。別有機關。合入無間地獄。明眼衲子應須自看。上堂。僧問。古人一喝不作一喝用。是否。師云是。僧便喝。師便棒。僧無語。師云。謔我。問古人道。有佛法處不得住。無佛法處急走過。意旨如何。師云。氣急殺人。僧擬議。師云。甚麼處去也。問只在目前。為甚麼再三不覩。師云。截耳臥街。僧云恰是。師云。令我攢眉。問黑豆未生芽時如何。師云。餧驢餧馬。進云。生後如何。師云。透水透沙。僧禮拜。師云。一似不齋來。問功巧諸技藝。盡現行此事。如何是此事。師云。諸方牓樣進云。莫便是學人會處也無。師云。有頭無尾漢。師乃云。過去諸如來。斯門已成就。放過一著。現在諸菩薩。今各入圓明。兩重公案。未來修學人。總被翠峯穿却鼻孔。上堂云。智者聊聞猛提取。莫待須臾失却頭。問丹霄獨步時如何。師云。脚下踏索。進云。天下橫行去也。師云。徐六擔板問學人乍入叢林。諸事不會。未審師還拯濟也無。師云。蘇州紙貴。進云。和尚豈無方便。師云。腦後拔榍。師云。爐鞴之所固無鈍鐵。良醫之門誰是病夫。向後鼻孔遼天。莫辜負人好。上堂云。欲得不招無間業。莫謗如來正法輪。便下座。上堂。纔有僧出禮拜。師云。大眾。一時記取者僧話頭。便下座。上堂。大眾雲集。以拄杖拋下云。棒頭有眼明如日。要識真金火裏看。上堂云。從天降下從地湧出。南北東西一棚俊鶻。顧杼停機苦屈苦屈。上堂云。古人道。譬如擲劍揮空。

Senses.Explanation: Two mirrors facing each other is an interview image: masters are asked what happens then, and the questioning monk in Xingkong Zhen's assembly supplies it as his own answer before Xingkong rejects it. Yangshan Huiji says two mutually illuminating mirrors have no image between them, and Guishan immediately replies that this claim has already established an image; Zhimen Shouqin answers the same no-image question by telling the questioner to hide the self; Xueyan Zuqin compares Bodhidharma and Emperor Wu’s exchange to mirrors meeting with no gap between them. Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J36/J36nB346.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Gulin Ru. Gulin calls a monk two-headed and three-faced in his own hall comment on a Xuefeng encounter, then pronounces his own verdict.

Senses.Explanation: Two heads and three faces. The phrase exposes divided, many-faced conduct in direct encounters. Poshan Haiming and Lianyue Daozheng use the expression as direct verdicts in their records; Yuanwu Keqin also gives it directly. Across the three exchanges it labels divided or many-sided conduct rather than supplying a general moral category. Gulin Jiru independently applies the verdict to a monk in a Xuefeng case and gives his own present judgment. Retained public meaning is supported by independent present uses in recorded discourse.

Senses.Note: The line cuts off both sides of a choice and pictures a sword standing cold against the sky. Four recorded masters use it in different settings: a question about earlier and present abbots, a midmonth turning point, a challenge to the division between arising and nonarising, and a question about support in the Linji line. It marks a decisive move that leaves neither side as a safe resting place.

Occurrences.Kwic: 左右逢原，尊卑異位，開鑿人天正眼，󳭪張佛祖門庭，頭頭垂應物之機，著著有出身之路，如斯話會，猶落今時。且如何是不落今時底句？玲瓏八面自回合，峭峻一方誰敢窺？上堂，舉：密菴和尚示眾云：十五日已前，開池不待月；十五日已後，池成月自來；正當十五日，吹無孔笛、唱太平歌，佛及眾生齊聲唱和。且超群拔萃一句作麼生道？四海浪平龍睡穩，九天雲淨鶴飛高。師云：山僧今日因行，不妨掉臂。十五日已前，長在途中，不離家舍；十五日已後，長在家舍，不離途中；正當十五日，兩頭俱坐斷，一劒倚天寒。且超群拔萃一句作麼生道？擊拂子：一把柳絲收不得，和煙搭在玉欄干。退院，上堂。老向山中償宿債，拖犁拽耙十三年，如今筋骨條條露，鼻孔頑然不受穿。村草步，舊田園，桃花如錦柳如煙，放教臥月眠雲去，飢有青蒭渴有泉。拍禪牀，下座。真讚真讚門人師楷文斌汝均等編觀音觀音枯木巖前坐片時，輪珠數盡復思惟。南詢童子無消息，月在波心說向誰。魚籃觀音魚籃觀音籃裡魚，衣內珠。左提右挈，腥風滿途。茫茫宇宙人無數，那箇男兒是丈夫。達磨達磨聖諦廓然，忠言逆耳。折蘆渡江

Occurrences.Kwic: 黃梅老人早是引蔓牽枝，瑞筠不肖向枝蔓上添芒索，每日與諸人從朝至暮、從夜至旦，見諸人不昏不散，便把這索子一掣，教你不坐在淨地上，抱不哭孩兒；諸人即昏即散，便把這索子一掣，教你不得和泥合水、指鹿為馬。諸人若總不與麼，到這裡須要認得祖翁面目是同是別？一回親見面，千載永難忘。復云：無一法從外而入，無一法從內而出，無一法和合而生，無一法自然而成。亦不見有生相，亦不見有住相，亦不見有異相，亦不見有滅相。於此覺得轉得，猶是以楔出楔。不以楔出楔時如何？兩頭俱坐斷，一劒倚天寒。上堂：雲悠悠，水悠悠，挑囊負鉢，今日明朝，撞著荒村破院。白滴滴，清寥寥，滴斷離膓點點愁，夜雨通宵。上堂：秋風蕭蕭，黃葉飄飄，來不在挽，去不在招。我且問你，世間與麼廣濶，因甚向鐘聲裏披起七條？上堂：要識金剛圈，以拂子擊右邊只者是；要識栗棘蓬，以拂子擊左邊只者是。吞得透得，無是不是，瞎驢曾受靈山記。施主入山齋僧，請上堂。實際理地，不受一塵。般若如大火聚，四面無可入。佛事門中，不舍一法。般若如清凉池，四面皆可到。妙在轉處，擬思即差。機不離位

Occurrences.Kwic: ，春樹暮雲。威鳳祥麟自出群。指座。法空寶座人人共登，須彌燈王猶較一級。登座，拈香祝聖罷，斂衣就座。護聖和尚白椎云：法筵龍象眾，當觀第一義。師云：有問有答，未出常情；無事無為，猶存知解。莫有獨脫無依底麼？不妨相見。僧出問：崑山那畔肯笑堂前，歸源正印早已親傳。今日籜峰祝聖開堂，願聞法要。師云：須彌頂上擊金鐘。進云：逈然一句超今古，高蹈毗盧頂上行。師云：不打者鼓笛。進云：昔日保壽開堂，三聖橫身相為；臨濟住院，普化盡力扶持。畢竟明箇什麼？師云：兩頭俱坐斷，一劒倚天寒。進云：與麼則五位君臣齊裂下，三玄戈甲一時收。師云：錯下名言。僧喝一喝，禮拜歸眾。師云：亂統禪和，如麻似粟。乃云：如我按指，海印發光。古佛堂前，敲空覓響。非風旛動，仁者心動。曹溪路上，好肉剜瘡。直饒別有生涯，也是和泥合水。今日新廣度為國開堂，畢竟合談何事？新羅與占波鬬額，燈籠與露柱交參。一切智智清淨，無二無二分，無別無斷故。正恁麼時，且道腦后一句是第幾機？良久：好把一枝無孔笛，等閑吹出萬年歡。復舉：夾山因僧問：如何是夾山境？山云：猿抱子
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X71/X71n1417.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Liaotang Weiyi. Liaotang voices the line in direct reply to a monk asking about the Linji line and its supporters.

Senses.Explanation: "Both ends cut off at once; one sword stands cold against the sky" turns refusal of a two-sided dilemma into one sharp image. Wuming gives it as an answer about former and present abbots; Pingshi says it at the midpoint between before and after. Haiyin applies it to arising and nonarising, while Liaotang answers a question about the Linji line.

Entries.SourceTerm: 彩雲影裏仙人現，手把紅羅扇遮面

Senses.PreferredTarget: An immortal appears amid colored clouds, shielding his face with a red gauze fan
AlternateTargets: An immortal appears in colored clouds, a red gauze fan covering his face
SearchAliases: colored clouds and red gauze fan
Senses.Note: The local challenge and the current teacher's response govern the reading; quoted evaluations are not universal factual claims.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師徵云：「既作臨濟兒孫，須識臨濟綱宗始得。不然，未免傷鋒犯手。或有人問磬山：『語默涉離微，如何通不犯？』豎起拂子云：『見麼？』且道與古人是同是別？不見當時佛鑑老人頌云：『彩雲影裏仙人現，手把紅羅扇遮面。急須著眼看仙人，莫看仙人手中扇。』」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J25/J25nB171.xml). Recorded Sayings of Monk Tianyin. Tianyin Yuanxiu quotes Fojian Huiqin's verse about an immortal appearing in colored clouds while a red gauze fan covers his face. Its following lines tell the reader to look at the immortal, not the fan. Tianyin first proposes raising his whisk as an answer to a question about speech and silence and asks whether this differs from the old teachers' answers; he then cites the verse. The concrete teaching object is thus also a possible distraction: the listener must examine the one using it. The verse does not authorize inventing a separate invisible being hidden behind every whisk or assuming that merely looking away from the object settles the question.

Occurrences.Kwic: 聊引一頌發明其意：彩雲影裏仙人現，手把紅羅扇遮面，急須著眼看仙人，莫看仙人手中扇。如何是仙人面？急著眼覷，已落第二。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J26/J26nB178.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Feiyin. Feiyin Tongrong introduces the complete fan verse to make his point, but immediately asks what the immortal's face is. Even urgently opening one's eyes to look has already fallen into the second position, he says. Fojian remains the cited poet, while Feiyin brings the instruction itself under examination. The warning prevents the reader from turning 'look at the immortal' into another fixed maneuver, as though one could locate a spiritual face by shifting physical attention from fan to holder. The face is demanded in the current teaching rather than described as a visible portrait.

Occurrences.Kwic: 四月八日，檀越供法衣，請上堂。師云：「佛佛授手，咸此法衣。彌勒千丈之軀，披來不短；釋迦丈六之身，搭來不長。今日披在寶華身上，耀古騰今，光明赫奕，正偏咸稱，左右逢源，入淨入穢，現土現身，利物應機，辨魔簡異。臨濟道：『我共你入淨玅國土中，著清淨衣說法身佛；入無差別國土中，著無差別衣說報身佛；入解脫國土中，著光明衣說化身佛。』三種國土皆是依變。諸人當知：一切佛法，教則頓漸偏圓、宗則三玄五位，皆是衣，不得在衣上認青、認黃、認赤、認白，須認著衣底人方有入作分。彩雲影裏仙人現，手把紅羅扇遮面，急須著眼看仙人，莫看仙人手中扇。寶華今日將佛衣、法衣一時脫卻，應時即事為諸人露箇消息去也。」良久，云：「𩖼𩖼熏風來入奏，赤條條地我為尊。」下座。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J34/J34nB300.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Chaozong. Receiving an offered religious robe on the Buddha's birthday, Chaozong Tongren quotes Linji's different lands and garments used to teach different Buddha-bodies. All doctrinal divisions and teaching arrangements are clothes, he says: do not merely identify their colors; recognize the wearer. He gives the immortal-and-fan verse and its instruction not to stare at the fan, then says he casts off both Buddha's clothes and teaching clothes to disclose the present matter. After a pause he answers with the warm wind and himself bare. The metaphor directs attention beyond the ceremonial covering without reporting that he physically stripped before the assembly.

Occurrences.Kwic: 上堂。「彩雲影裏仙人現，手把紅羅扇遮面。急須著眼看仙人，莫看仙人手中扇。」拂衫袖曰：「者是彩雲影。」揮拂子曰：「者是紅羅扇。作麼生是仙人面？團耶方耶？長耶短耶？紅黃黑白耶？諸仁者！不用看他，只須自看。驀地看破自己面孔，始識儂家面孔。識得儂家面孔，方見仙人面孔。面孔且置，且道適來者一絡索落在什麼處？」震威一喝曰：「霧露雲霞時起滅，長青自古一般天。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J38/J38nB429.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Gulin (Prajñā) of Fengtian, Shengjing. Gulin Zhi recites the whole verse, shakes his robe sleeve as the colored cloud and waves his whisk as the red fan. What is the immortal's face: round or square, long or short, or one of the colors? Stop looking at someone else, he says; see one's own face, then his, then the immortal's. He then asks where all that talk falls, shouts and caps it with mist and clouds arising and vanishing against the enduring sky. The current performance recreates the verse to test the assembly, rather than supplying a literal description of an immortal's appearance.

Occurrences.Kwic: 佛果在五祖為元座，有僧請益，風穴語：默涉離微，如何通不犯因緣？偶佛鑑來，果曰：懃兄可為頌出布施他。鑑即頌曰：彩雲影裏仙人現，手把紅羅扇遮面。急須著眼看仙人，莫看仙人手中扇。果深喜之。雪竇道：劈腹剜心又作麼生？萬松道：麤言及細語，皆歸第一義。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X67/X67n1307.xml). Elder Wansong’s Commentary and Chanted Remarks on Master Tiantong Jue’s Picking Up Ancient Cases: Record of Requests for Instruction. Wansong Xingxiu recounts how Yuanwu Keqin, serving as head monk at Wuzu, was asked about Fengxue's speech-and-silence case. When Fojian arrived, Yuanwu asked him to compose a verse for the learner. Fojian produced the cloud, immortal and fan poem, and Yuanwu was pleased. Wansong then places it beside Xuedou's demand to cut open the belly and expose the heart, commenting that rough and refined words alike return to the foremost meaning. This witness explicitly names the poet and the teaching occasion. The quoted apparition is a crafted image answering a case, not a report of an immortal seen by Fojian.

Entries.SourceTerm: 彩鳳翻飛身自在，鐵牛奔吼意常閒

Senses.PreferredTarget: A many-colored phoenix wheels freely; an iron ox bellows with its mind at ease.
SearchAliases: A many-colored phoenix wheels freely; an iron ox bellows with its mind at ease
Senses.Note: The impossible animal images describe unrestricted action with untroubled awareness. The pair is poetry within a transmission exchange, not a claim about animals.

Occurrences.Kwic: 關，因閱萬松拈提若面墻者久之，忽一日有省，曰：「此宗非絕後再甦、懸崖撒手者，要望他針線細密，盤旋回互，不觸當頭、兔子搆牛奶，萬萬不可得。」既而幡然出關，參定國從公，得大發明，從撫而印之。拈云：「閱故典有省，古來不無其人。乃復出關參訪，足見此老行已嚴密，不輕自肯，自不可與高亭、玄沙輩同日而語，宜其厚德為洞宗棟梁、法門軌範矣。至如他於定國處得大發明，畢竟發明箇甚麼？若謂本分事，既言本分，豈容他發得明？若不然者，爭又恁麼說？有能於此端的，得許伊承嗣嵩山。」燕京宗鏡院大章宗書禪師燕京宗鏡院大章宗書禪師因廩山忠參，值師外出，山迎而問曰：「達磨面壁石何在？」師指曰：「嗚，那青青黯黯處。」曰：「指東話西作麼？」師曰：「杜撰禪和，如麻似粟。」曰：「者漢在者裏，擬魔魅人那？」師便打。拈云：「廩山當時腳跟若不穩當，幾被者漢賺落青青黯黯底，至今無出頭處。雖然，爭奈到頭遭他屈棒。」西京少室幻休常潤禪師西京少室幻休常潤禪師參小山書公，一日入室呈偈，書把住曰：「子母勦說，更須自入悟門。」師曰：「常不借緣，從何門入？」曰：「既不借緣，何為至此？」師曰：「因不借緣，所以至此。」曰：「就不借緣一語，於意云何？」師曰：「彩鳳翻飛身自在，鐵牛奔吼意常閒。」書遂付以大法。拈云：「少室不借緣則灼然，未免向異類中露出聲跡。」建昌廩山蘊空常忠禪師建昌廩山蘊空常忠禪師受宗鏡付囑，隱從姑山。有顧問者，師但搖手曰：「汝不會我語。」曰：「試說看。」師曰：「南城城外水，滔滔向北流。」問者瞪目。師曰：「向道汝不會我語。」拈云：「廩山倘見顧問者，但瞪目視之，豈特疑殺天下人？亦可使將佛法當等閑不得。」順德蓬鵲山天然圓佐禪師順德蓬鵲山天然圓佐禪師蓬岩吳柱史問：「如何是般若體？」師曰：「寂然不動。」曰：「如何是般若用？」師曰：「感而遂通。」拈云：「蓬山將謂因人說法，善赴來機，不知不唯誤人，而且誤法。何故？若指寂然不動為體，則青山白石何嘗非寂然乎？感而遂通為用，則春鳥夏蟲何嘗非感通乎？要知曹溪波浪如相似，無限平人被陸沉。噓！也是證龜成鱉。」燕京大覺寺慈舟方念禪師燕京大覺寺慈舟方念禪師依少室潤公作維那，一日，遊初祖面壁處，忽然契悟，乃曰：「五乳峰前好箇消息，大小石頭塊塊著地。」呈潤，潤可之。拈云：「大覺恁麼契悟，還諦當也無？若諦當，則未舉游步已前，石頭豈不著地？若不諦當，少室何為印可？於此見得分明，兩父子天然妙絕。」嵩山無言正道禪師嵩山無言正道禪師僧問：「如何是新

Occurrences.Kwic: 璣滿地拋。闌干斜倚，憑誰語，兩岸芙蕖，露滴晚香飄。任公釣錦鰲，釣得錦鰲透碧霄。翻憶西湖，月下弄笙簫，柳鎖長隄十二橋。第三十三祖月舟文載大師掩關，閱《萬松機緣》有省，嘆曰：「洞上宗風大播天下，有織錦回文之功，非鍼線細密，盤旋回互，不觸當頭者，不能與伊作主也。」既而幡然出關，參無方從公，發明己見，撫而印之。春雨山花燦錦，秋風落葉飛金。夜靜幽人得意，猿啼旅客傷心。等閒若不登高朢，爭見東流海漾深？第三十四祖宗鏡宗書大師，聞月舟法席之盛，入室請益，密踐八載，蒙付囑。後少室請師，師慨曰：「先師化後三十餘年，洞上宗風迨乎湮沒。」遂主之，臨終，索筆書偈曰：「宗鏡宗鏡，心法成行。即日圓覺，鏡破宗正。」招手悟猶鈍，那堪八載周？無脣不是兔，有角亦非牛。春信梅花曉，琴聲月下悠。華亭誰更委，翻卻釣魚舟。第三十五祖西京幻休常潤大師參宗鏡，問：「鏡中現像時如何？」曰：「何不打破？」師曰：「其奈鏡像何？」曰：「鏡像安在？」師有省。一日，舉「我今不是渠」，詰之曰：「既不是渠，畢竟是何人？」師曰：「若要識此人，有箇真消息。無相滿虛空，有形沒蹤跡。曾為佛祖師，常作乾坤則。龜毛拂子清風生，兔角杖頭明月出。」鏡復徵之，師曰：「彩鳳翻飛身自在，鐵牛奔吼意常閒。」曰：「善哉。」水潺潺，山疊疊，蹭蹬天涯老劍客。江北江南遍問津，芒鞋蹋綻路頭絕。風吹柳絮走毛毬，雨打梨花飛蛺蝶。乳酪醍醐味不殊，瓶盤釵釧金非別。休休休，直一橛，轉盼家山雲外月。他家父子好機關，說甚臨濟白拈賊。第三十六祖大覺方念大師，參幻休，休問：「甚處來？」師曰：「北方。」曰：「北方道法與此方何如？」師曰：「水分千派，流出一源。」一日，遊初祖面壁處，契悟，乃曰：「五乳峰前，好箇消息，大小石頭，塊塊著地。」詣室呈休，休囑曰：「無上涅槃心，佛祖相傳付。吾今授受時，雲淨峰頭露。」乳峰嶮巇人難到，到者應須膽也銷，紫電光中鳴布鼓，桃花浪裏看騰蛟。頭角昂而機用別，風雲際而意氣豪，遞相承授兮水向源濁，體佛祖心兮霜妒花嬌。眾生末法真堪嘆，艸木皆兵何處逃？第三十七祖雲門圓澂大師掩關，看乾峰「舉一不得舉二」話發明，詣雲棲，棲舉「海底泥牛」，師推出傍僧，曰：「大眾證明。」後參大覺，覺曰：「止風塗向青山近，越王城畔滄海遙時如何？」師曰：「月穿滄海破，波斯不展眉。」復呈偈，覺曰：「語句綿密，不落始終，真當家種艸。向後開兩片皮，截斷天下人舌頭有分在。」一鎚奮力碎重關，直透雷門萬仞山。江練靜，暮雲閒，奪得靈符肘後

Occurrences.Kwic: 謨定命，扶捄自許，于時言言，于時語語。五乳峰前看月華，皇皇穆穆是誰家？青原第二十九世，西京幻休大千常潤禪師。始閱修多羅，有所警發，後參小山，聞舉洞山「我今不是渠」，師於言下領悟，以偈呈小山曰：「若要識此人，有箇真消息，無相滿虛空，有形沒蹤跡。曾為佛祖師，常作乾坤則，龜毛拂子清風生，兔角杖頭明月出。」山曰：「子母勦說，須自入悟門。」師曰：「當不借緣，從何門入？」山曰：「既不借緣，何為至此？」師曰：「因不借緣，所以至此。」山曰：「就不借緣，於意云何？」師曰：「彩鳳翻飛身自在，鐵牛奔吼意常閒。」山許是克家種艸，即以洞上法印付之，略曰：「定作人天主，當思少室秋。」入海量沙，循山採藻，心志徒勞何日了。一朝撲碎古菱花，妍醜分明都自曉。橫身鬧市邊，垂手撫八埏。杖頭風月本無價，奮肆施為緣不借。少室始基永勿移，新豐振古洵如茲。青原第三十世，燕京大覺寺慈舟方念禪師。參幻休和尚，一見便問：「甚處來？」師曰：「北方。」休曰：「北方道法與此方何如？」師曰：「水分千派，流出一源。」休見其語異，命充堂司。一日，遊初祖面壁處，豁然契悟，曰：「五乳峰前好箇消息，大小石頭塊塊著地。」以偈呈休，遂印可付法。偈曰：「無上涅槃心，佛祖相傳付。吾今授受時，雲淨峰頭露。」時感蕭晨尋哲匠，機觸箭鋒不少讓，乳峰石上連歌唱。

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 璣滿地拋。闌干斜倚，憑誰語，兩岸芙蕖，露滴晚香飄。任公釣錦鰲，釣得錦鰲透碧霄。翻憶西湖，月下弄笙簫，柳鎖長隄十二橋。第三十三祖月舟文載大師掩關，閱《萬松機緣》有省，嘆曰：「洞上宗風大播天下，有織錦回文之功，非鍼線細密，盤旋回互，不觸當頭者，不能與伊作主也。」既而幡然出關，參無方從公，發明己見，撫而印之。春雨山花燦錦，秋風落葉飛金。夜靜幽人得意，猿啼旅客傷心。等閒若不登高朢，爭見東流海漾深？第三十四祖宗鏡宗書大師，聞月舟法席之盛，入室請益，密踐八載，蒙付囑。後少室請師，師慨曰：「先師化後三十餘年，洞上宗風迨乎湮沒。」遂主之，臨終，索筆書偈曰：「宗鏡宗鏡，心法成行。即日圓覺，鏡破宗正。」招手悟猶鈍，那堪八載周？無脣不是兔，有角亦非牛。春信梅花曉，琴聲月下悠。華亭誰更委，翻卻釣魚舟。第三十五祖西京幻休常潤大師參宗鏡，問：「鏡中現像時如何？」曰：「何不打破？」師曰：「其奈鏡像何？」曰：「鏡像安在？」師有省。一日，舉「我今不是渠」，詰之曰：「既不是渠，畢竟是何人？」師曰：「若要識此人，有箇真消息。無相滿虛空，有形沒蹤跡。曾為佛祖師，常作乾坤則。龜毛拂子清風生，兔角杖頭明月出。」鏡復徵之，師曰：「彩鳳翻飛身自在，鐵牛奔吼意常閒。」曰：「善哉。」水潺潺，山疊疊，蹭蹬天涯老劍客。江北江南遍問津，芒鞋蹋綻路頭絕。風吹柳絮走毛毬，雨打梨花飛蛺蝶。乳酪醍醐味不殊，瓶盤釵釧金非別。休休休，直一橛，轉盼家山雲外月。他家父子好機關，說甚臨濟白拈賊。第三十六祖大覺方念大師，參幻休，休問：「甚處來？」師曰：「北方。」曰：「北方道法與此方何如？」師曰：「水分千派，流出一源。」一日，遊初祖面壁處，契悟，乃曰：「五乳峰前，好箇消息，大小石頭，塊塊著地。」詣室呈休，休囑曰：「無上涅槃心，佛祖相傳付。吾今授受時，雲淨峰頭露。」乳峰嶮巇人難到，到者應須膽也銷，紫電光中鳴布鼓，桃花浪裏看騰蛟。頭角昂而機用別，風雲際而意氣豪，遞相承授兮水向源濁，體佛祖心兮霜妒花嬌。眾生末法真堪嘆，艸木皆兵何處逃？第三十七祖雲門圓澂大師掩關，看乾峰「舉一不得舉二」話發明，詣雲棲，棲舉「海底泥牛」，師推出傍僧，曰：「大眾證明。」後參大覺，覺曰：「止風塗向青山近，越王城畔滄海遙時如何？」師曰：「月穿滄海破，波斯不展眉。」復呈偈，覺曰：「語句綿密，不落始終，真當家種艸。向後開兩片皮，截斷天下人舌頭有分在。」一鎚奮力碎重關，直透雷門萬仞山。江練靜，暮雲閒，奪得靈符肘後

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 謨定命，扶捄自許，于時言言，于時語語。五乳峰前看月華，皇皇穆穆是誰家？青原第二十九世，西京幻休大千常潤禪師。始閱修多羅，有所警發，後參小山，聞舉洞山「我今不是渠」，師於言下領悟，以偈呈小山曰：「若要識此人，有箇真消息，無相滿虛空，有形沒蹤跡。曾為佛祖師，常作乾坤則，龜毛拂子清風生，兔角杖頭明月出。」山曰：「子母勦說，須自入悟門。」師曰：「當不借緣，從何門入？」山曰：「既不借緣，何為至此？」師曰：「因不借緣，所以至此。」山曰：「就不借緣，於意云何？」師曰：「彩鳳翻飛身自在，鐵牛奔吼意常閒。」山許是克家種艸，即以洞上法印付之，略曰：「定作人天主，當思少室秋。」入海量沙，循山採藻，心志徒勞何日了。一朝撲碎古菱花，妍醜分明都自曉。橫身鬧市邊，垂手撫八埏。杖頭風月本無價，奮肆施為緣不借。少室始基永勿移，新豐振古洵如茲。青原第三十世，燕京大覺寺慈舟方念禪師。參幻休和尚，一見便問：「甚處來？」師曰：「北方。」休曰：「北方道法與此方何如？」師曰：「水分千派，流出一源。」休見其語異，命充堂司。一日，遊初祖面壁處，豁然契悟，曰：「五乳峰前好箇消息，大小石頭塊塊著地。」以偈呈休，遂印可付法。偈曰：「無上涅槃心，佛祖相傳付。吾今授受時，雲淨峰頭露。」時感蕭晨尋哲匠，機觸箭鋒不少讓，乳峰石上連歌唱。

Senses.Explanation: A many-colored phoenix wheels freely; an iron ox bellows with its mind at ease. The impossible animal images describe unrestricted action with untroubled awareness. Huanzhu Changrun speaks the line in the inherited case. Huigong Xiong comments in J35nB336; Baiyu adds a verse in J36nB359; Hansong Cao adds a verse in J37nB392. Zhe’an Fan adds a separate verse after the quoted case in J36nB369. The complete saying and full turn control the sense. The pair is poetry within a transmission exchange, not a claim about animals.

Occurrences.Kwic: 悟不由情，臨終能轉業。偶閱唐史，李訓之敗，被綠衣詭言黜官，走終南依密。密欲匿之，其徒不可，乃奔鳳翔，為盩庢吏所執。訓死，仇士良捕密詰之，怡然曰：與訓游久，吾法遇難則救，初無愛憎，死固吾分。予謂比丘於唐交士大夫者，或見於傳記，多犯法辱教，而圭峰獨超然如此，為史者亦欣然點筆疾書，盖其履踐之明也。觀其偈，則無不欲透脫情境，譬如香象擺壞鐵鏁，自在而去，豈若蠅為唾所涴哉？雲菴住歸宗時，方送法眼大師茶毗，時雨新霽，泥方滑，道忽躂倒，大眾爭掖而起，舉火把曰：法眼茶毗，歸宗遭攧。呈似大眾，更無可說。石頭大師作參同契，其末曰：謹白參玄人，光陰莫虗度。法眼禪師注曰：住！住！恩大難酬，法眼可謂見先德之心矣。眾生日用以妄想顛倒自蔽光明，故多遺時失候，謂之虗度光陰。有道者無他，能善用其心耳。故趙州曰：一切但仍舊。從上諸聖無不從仍舊中得。大智度論曰：眾生心性猶如利刀，唯用割泥，泥無所成，刀日就損。理體常妙，眾生自麤。能善用之，即合本妙。首楞嚴曰：佛謂阿難：譬如琴瑟、箜篌、琵琶，雖有妙音，若無妙指，終不能發。汝與眾生亦復如是，寶覺真心各各圓滿，如我按指，海印發光。汝暫舉心，塵勞先起。華嚴偈曰：若人欲識佛境界，當淨其意如虗空。遠離妄想及諸見，令心所向皆無礙。大智禪師曰：夫教語皆是三句相連，初、中、後善。初直須教渠發善心，中破善，後始明善。菩薩

Senses.Explanation: “Kindness surpassing that of parents” is emphatic gratitude for help that enables a person to see for himself. Tianyin Yuanxiu uses it in a substitute reply praising Xuansha's patient pointing. Three independent records preserve Xiangyan saying it of Guishan precisely because Guishan refused to explain and thereby did not deprive him of his own awakening. Juelang Daosheng extends the expression to teachings whose words can enable a reader to enter their meaning.
Senses.Note: The comparison magnifies a teacher's benefit; it does not depreciate parents. In the Xiangyan story, the surpassing kindness is the refusal to supply a second-hand answer.

Occurrences.Kwic: 不備也。茲者，大師之孫堅如欲募刻師《夢遊全集》，特請為序而贊成之，予嘉其為法忘軀之誠，因述余仰止慕慨之思云爾。紫竹林集序紫竹林集序孔子曰：「辭達而已矣。」教中云：「宗通而後說通。」蓋情見乎辭，不以辭害意，正是意句俱得，宗說皆通也。況文言為載道之器，非文言則道不足以傳。如吾佛祖，皆生西域，滅度之久，孰能知之？亦必籍此言教，始得親見親聞，始知吾人具有，秪因迷悟而差失耳。末法捨此文字言教，又從何而悟入乎？予癸未冬，于金陵會顓大師，相與莫逆，偶別往浙，扶竿徑山。今日重來白門，而師已示寂于紫竹林矣。予深悼而弔之，其室中有千輻、佛地二子，彙師生平法語著作，名《紫竹林集》以請余曰：「此吾師生平之骨髓，師意不欲人序，故闕如也。師獨推重和上，和上俄至，則此感應道交，甚為奇特，末後光明，不待和上發揮之，而誰望乎？」余謂紫竹言教，久信海內，何用更贅？但師之法語著作，皆從胸中流出，稱性而談，所謂言與心親、行與道合，非世人揣摩摹擬之辭翰，與浮言過實者所可比也。有能讀此集，知其意句嚗嚗落處，則亦可從此悟入心性之密，恩逾父母矣。法乳所流，寧有窮哉？重刻證道歌註頌序重刻證道歌註頌序還丹一粒，點銕成金；至理一言，轉凡成聖。此惟吾宗門足以當之，故予嘗令學人熟讀寶誌公《十二時歌》、傅大士《心王銘》、三祖《信心銘》、永嘉《證道歌》、石頭《參同契》、雲巖《寶鏡三昧》諸著作，參研久之，自能隨事觸機，頓入圓明玅性。何則？此諸祖如大醫王，從曠劫來遍採奇異方藥，修煉微玅靈丹，末法之人何幸遇此？如靈丹在口，但能信而吞之，便足起死回生，轉凡成聖，豈非《證道歌》中所謂「粉骨碎身未足酬，一句了然超百億」乎？世人以諸祖無有法嗣，又孰知愈於有法嗣者之法乳益深乎？吾弟子姚愚谷嘗隨予廬山圓通，偶得竺源禪師所註《頌證道歌》，不啻如獲髻珠，深為秘惜。去年攜來金陵，質顓大師贊其梓行，亦自於林中剃落，改號千輻。今復乞予序其流通之意，予曰：「善哉！從上諸祖不吝修證之勞，以自受用者施於末法，而末法自惟將何以報深恩？今子廣為流通，何嘗非析骨刺血之意乎？雖然，莫將容易得，便作等閒看。惟真琉瓶能盛獅乳，其他則裂也。醍醐毒藥，辨之者誰？往往一等癡狂，拾得古人現成

Senses.Explanation: The responsive jewel is a luminous precious object whose displayed color changes with its surroundings. Yongming Yanshou quotes a description in which it shines in darkness, warms or cools, and shows colors in water. Gulin Qingmao’s verse describes its cold light spreading day and night. Liao’an Qingyu raises Yongjia Xuanjue’s inherited jewel verse, while an unnamed monk asks Zihu Lizong about the jewel’s own color. These uses establish a responsive, color-following jewel; they do not themselves define it by wish fulfillment.

Senses.Explanation: People fail to recognize the mani pearl; it is kept close within the Tathagata storehouse. The quoted pearl and storehouse challenge a seeker to identify what cannot be found by grasping an object. Four active Tier-2 deployments by Wanru, Zhuyan Yan, Chulin, and Pufuzhuo. Nanquan turns the search back on the questioner; later masters ask where the pearl is or give their own pointed replies. The pearl and storehouse are images within a Chan exchange, not a physical jewel or container.

Senses.Explanation: The great vehicle is a named body of teaching that Chan masters announce, quote, test, and sometimes declare insufficient. Baizhang Huaihai gives the corpus's direct word-by-word gloss: ‘mahā means great; yāna means vehicle’ (摩訶是大義衍是乘義). Yangshan Huiji announces the great-vehicle teaching from the second seat in his dream, saying that it leaves the four propositions and cuts off the hundred negations. Miyun Yuanwu then says Yangshan should have left when invited to speak instead of sounding the block and following the invitation. The term is not merely inherited apparatus. Gusu Zun uses his own ascent of the teaching seat to proclaim it and says everyone has it. Hanyue Fazang then supplies a characteristic Chan check: even the great-vehicle teaching beyond the propositions and negations is ‘good indeed, yet not completely good’ (美則美矣，猶未盡善).

Senses.Explanation: The equation of afflictions with awakening is explained through knowing, but its use is sharply restricted: Dahui rejects merely saying it before the matter has been penetrated. The equation reverses the usual opposition between afflictions and awakening, and Chan records both state that reversal and police its recitation. Yuan Cheng answers the direct question by rendering awakening as knowing and perceiving. He says confusion about awakening is called affliction, knowing affliction is awakening, and storing up that knowing is again called affliction. Dahui rebukes people who force the proposition while their conduct contradicts their talk and says only after breaking through may one say it. The Record of Ancient Venerables likewise records beginners claiming a uniform equalized view while their ordinary-and-holy and still-and-noisy distinctions remain twofold. The corpus presents an equation whose repetition masters openly challenge.

Senses.Explanation: ‘Be rain and dew in the sea of affliction, clouds and thunder on the mountain of ignorance’ places effective action inside hard conditions. Masters use its weather images to answer how help, awakening or a staff's force can reach a world still bound up in vexation. Weilin Daopei offers the pair as an alternative to an earlier master's clear-sky answer, then asks whether the two really match. At an ordination, Linye Tongqi uses it to answer what benefiting living beings would be. Baiyu Jingsi asks where a deceased teacher now is and answers with the sea and mountain. Hanxiu Ruqian asks what his staff does after speaking of removing shackles and gives the same images. Hansong Zhicao pictures generations of ancestors acting as rain, dew, cloud and thunder in hard places. Gulin Qingmao uses the pair when asked for one line reaching this side and that, past and present, killing and giving life.

Senses.Explanation: “A mangy horse tethered to a dead stake” is a fixed image for rigid fixation and loss of freedom. Feiyin Tongrong applies it to being bound by verbal schemes and immediately says this leaves no freedom; Yinyuan Longqi independently makes it the result of dead, one-sided fixation. Guxue calls a merely repeated mind-is-Buddha formula a scabby horse tethered to a dead stake. Yuanan applies the scabby-horse image to a frozen use of Buddha preaching in his own fire-opening hall talk.

Occurrences.Kwic: 堂，舉：鹿門和尚一日有僧相訪，僧問云：如何是鹿門家風？門云：有鹽有醋。僧云：如何是道中人？門云：口似鼻孔。僧云：忽遇客來，將何祗待？門云：柴門草戶，謝子經過。師拈云：鹿門家風大展，水洩不通，既無受璧之心，安有割城之意？今日忽有人問金山：如何是金山家風？只向他道：八面玲瓏。如何是道中人直出直入？忽遇客來，將何祗待？餅飜江上月，鱠縷屋頭雲。且道金山與麼答話，與鹿門相去多少？擊拂子一下，云：酒逢知己飲，詩向會人吟。謝秉拂，幹齋，上堂。玉鑑光中，波澄月現。展屠龍手，提金剛劒。栗棘金圈一拶開，從君細嚼渾崙嚥。有照有用，有舒有卷。楊岐消息未全灰，優曇華笑春風面。卓拄杖一下，喝一喝。歲旦，上堂。年年是好年，日日是好日，新年人看舊年人，舊年日是新年日。潮生漲舊痕，潮落石頭出，萬物有遷流，遷流無變易。有變易，卓拄杖一下，云：上上大吉。涅槃，上堂：釋迦老子弄精魂，死了依前似不曾。一樹落花春過後，遠山無限碧層層。上堂。風

Senses.Explanation: An ordinary word for a poet; one retained Chan exchange uses it in a verdict on a presented verse. After an unnamed questioner cites the line about showing a sword to a swordsman and a poem only to a poet, Dayu calls him 'an accomplished poet.' Other retained occurrences are poem titles or ordinary references to poets. Shengke speaks an original verse in his exchange with a monk, using the poet as the one who would gather falling blossoms.
